_about: Every fixed UI text, by key, on both platforms (android Strings.kt, ios RemoteCore Strings.swift): the key names are the same, the wording is byte-identical to what each platform showed before. {phone} is 'phone'/'telemóvel' on Android and 'iPhone' on iOS. 'platforms' lists where a key exists; a platform-specific en/pt overrides the shared one. Texts with values in them (counts, names, codes) are still written where they are used. Intended differences: bin vs swipe to forget a TV, Share (Android) vs the share sheet (iOS), the iOS Local Network hint and Shortcuts error, and iOS's 'Apps' and 'Close'.
